build.technology: Electron 43 + electron-builder one-click NSIS installer only
build.runtimeStrategy: Electron runtime bundled; updater runtime copied from the exact lockfile into resources/updater-runtime; ExcelJS copied from the locked workspace/vendor tree
build.payloadAllowlist: workspace/package.json build.files and build.extraResources; developer-local OAuth overrides excluded; validated generated desktop OAuth release configuration included only in the packaged app and ignored by Git

identity.versionComparisonPolicy: three numeric components; only a numerically newer installer may update; same-version reinstall and downgrade are blocked
identity.installDirectory: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/CMOE Workspace for new installs; an existing registered installation is updated in place
identity.userDataDirectory: %APPDATA%/cmoe-workspace; embedded Gmail Flow remains under %APPDATA%/cmoe-workspace/gmail-flow-desktop with the legacy root checked for migration
identity.mutexNameAndUserScope: Electron requestSingleInstanceLock for the current Windows user/session
identity.activationEvent: Electron second-instance event restores or focuses the existing window unless update shutdown has begun
identity.legacyIdentityAndMigration: Preserve appId, productName and existing user-data roots from the recovered 1.14.8 installer

maintenance.detectionMethod: electron-builder per-user uninstall registration and its install-path preservation
maintenance.installerMode: one-click NSIS; fresh install and newer-version update require no Next/Finish pages
maintenance.sameOrOlderManualInstall: show an informative message and quit without overwriting the installed app
maintenance.removal: Windows Installed apps or the registered uninstaller
maintenance.shortcutAndUninstallerPolicy: one canonical desktop shortcut, one canonical Start menu shortcut and one uninstaller; updates target the same registered installation and electron-builder refreshes the shortcuts

data.migrationAndRollback: Every packaged version transition creates a separate pre-migration snapshot under %APPDATA%/CMOE Workspace Backups before opening stored data. Before update installation, all renderers flush, document tools and Gmail queues drain, Drive sync finishes, and another local snapshot is required. Drive mode additionally requires a versioned hidden-app-data backup excluding OAuth tokens and Apps Script secrets. Any failed mandatory step aborts installation. Schema changes require an explicit tested migration; installer and uninstaller never delete user data.

update.transitionFeedFor11545: https://cresero.com/downloads/cmoe-workspace/update.json points the legacy 1.15.45 client to the one-time 1.15.46 bridge installer
update.verification: electron-updater validates standard SHA-512 metadata; NSIS validates and replaces the registered installation; differential download uses the blockmap when possible
update.downloadPolicy: autoDownload=false; autoInstallOnAppQuit=false; disableWebInstaller=true; user starts download from the app
update.windowShutdownPolicy: collect every BrowserWindow owned by the CMOE process, flush and disable them, block new program/roster/second-instance work, complete queues/sync/backups, then hand off to quitAndInstall(false, true); external Chrome/Edge login windows are not owned and are left open
update.restartOwner: electron-updater and one-click NSIS own installation and exactly one automatic restart; no PowerShell bootstrap, Windows Forms helper, custom installer process polling, or manual restart owner remains
update.logging: electron-log file transport remains enabled; packaged console transport is disabled to avoid GUI-process EPIPE failures

ui.manualUpdateMenu: 환경 설정 > 프로그램 업데이트 > 새 버전 확인
ui.newVersionIndicator: settings panel and the existing PROGRAM UPDATE dialog
ui.downloadProgress: real transferred bytes and percentage from electron-updater
ui.installationProgress: after app windows close, the native one-click NSIS progress window is the source of truth; no fabricated installation percentage
ui.completionNotice: consumed once by the main Workspace renderer; opening Gmail Flow, document editor, or other child windows cannot repeat it
